description:
Azamat Cardenas-Mukherjee-Kulkarni are tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. They taught themself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know them best. They work as a broker out of Dockside, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Azamat Cardenas-Mukherjee-Kulkarni are the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who they burned last.

psychology.secret: Halima Lindgren-Ofori once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

Someone is impersonating Halima Lindgren-Ofori on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation â€” checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Counts ammunition obsessively â€” knows the exact round count at all times
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything â€” late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware â€” chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Losing their primary augmentation â€” the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Complex blend of South Asian (42.2%), Central Asian (27.4%), Hispanic/Latin American (16.3%), and Eastern European (14.1%) ancestry. This combination produces warm medium-to-deep brown skin with subtle golden and olive undertones characteristic of South Asian-Central Asian mixing, layered with the warmer reddish-golden tones from Hispanic heritage. The Central and Eastern European components add depth and complexity to the overall melanin expression, contributing to the pronounced cheekbone definition and facial angularity while maintaining the warm base tone.

physical_description.complexion: Angular features with prominent cheekbones and defined jawline reflecting the strong influence of South Asian and Central Asian ancestry structures, sharpened further by Eastern European heritage contributing to the broad-plane facial geometry. The overall facial structure is lean and high-boned, with warm golden-olive undertones creating subtle shadow patterns across the face. Skin is clear but bearing the strain of chronic augmentation integration â€” faint inflammation scars around the temples and along the mandible in thin, surgical lines. No cosmetic grooming; appearance is entirely functional.

Breathing is controlled and deliberate. When still, there is a visible tension in the shoulders and hands, as if the body is perpetually coiled.
